QUOTE: "`library/` contains no `pthread_create`, `std::thread` or `_beginthread`. The library never creates a thread."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states that the library creates no threads, but it never says library/ supplies the mutex abstraction (threading layer) for threaded callers. It only says mutex code is compiled out by default and tells users to enable `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` with PTHREAD or ALT.
